concept: Late bar toast by the games table
creativeDirection: Night location photography: a crisp editorial bar interior built around one recognisable portrait, with a few album motifs translated into ordinary bar objects and surfaces.
scene: A warmly lit old bar interior at night, seen from eye level across the corner of a booth beside a small games table, with the room falling away softly behind.

elements.element: the man from reference image 1 seated in a booth, smiling and raising a stemmed cocktail glass toward the camera
a pair of round eyeglasses resting on the games table beside him
an acoustic guitar leaning naturally against the booth end near the wall
a small hourglass standing on a back shelf behind the bar
an antique sepia-toned globe on a shelf near the bottles
black, white, and skin-pink floral upholstery pattern on the booth seating
deep black background areas and warm peach highlights in the skin tones
clean white negative space in the tabletop and wall accents

coverSummaries.album: 20th Century Paddy The Songs Of Shane MacGowan
coverSummaries.description: A black-and-white portrait of one adult man seated and smiling, holding up a stemmed cocktail glass toward the viewer. Behind him is a dense collage-like wall of white chalk-style doodles, handwritten marks, symbols, figures, bottles, hearts, crosses, faces, and rough sketches on black. Small gold-toned highlights appear on some jewelry and the drink.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: smiling man raising a cocktail glass before a wall of doodles
coverSummaries.people: one man seated, smiling, and holding up a cocktail glass

coverSummaries.description: A centered photograph of a shirtless person's back and neck, cropped from just below the shoulders upward, with a large tattoo across the upper back. The image is framed by dense black-and-white illustrated flowers and roses around all edges.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: tattooed bare back framed by flowers
coverSummaries.people: one person seen from behind with a tattooed back

coverSummaries.description: A soft outdoor portrait of two adult men from the chest up against a blurred pale blue background. The man on the left wears round glasses and has partially shaved hair with long dreadlocks; the man on the right has medium brown hair and looks upward. Both wear dark buttoned shirts.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: two men posed against a soft blue sky-like background
coverSummaries.people: two men standing side by side in dark shirts

coverSummaries.description: A staged interior photograph of a bright living room with five adult men arranged around the space. One sits holding an acoustic guitar on a sofa, one reclines on the wooden floor in the foreground, one sits near a television, and two stand or sit toward the back. The room contains a fireplace, shelves, framed pictures, plants, a globe-like hanging object, glasses of red drink, bottles, and another guitar leaning near the window.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: five men posed in a living room
coverSummaries.people: five men posed around a living room, including one lying on the floor and one holding a guitar

coverSummaries.description: A surreal painted scene with a large yellow horned face floating above a freestanding brown door in a green valley between pale mountains. Around it are clouds, a flying swallow, a giant eye in a pearl-like frame, a severed-looking red clawed arm, a skeletal hand, an hourglass, a shell, a playing card, a small blue devil-like figure carrying a red bundle, a tiny dog, a flaming black figure, and a balloon basket carrying a human head and a white animal.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: large yellow horned face above a door

coverSummaries.description: A sepia-toned composite image showing four adult men standing full-length across a world map floor beneath a cloudy sky. The figures wear dark, slim-fitting clothes; one has a wide-brim hat, one a flat cap and scarf. The composition places the men along the lower middle with large empty sky above.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: four men standing on a world map
coverSummaries.people: four men standing in a line on a map-like floor

coverSummaries.description: A close-up, high-contrast photograph of a human mannequin or medical dummy head and upper chest against a black background. The face is tilted upward with closed eyes and open mouth, and round electrode pads are attached to the chest. The image is grainy with warm skin tones and stark black surrounding it.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: upturned mannequin-like face with chest electrodes

coverSummaries.description: A sparse white cover with a black-and-white image of a young girl crawling forward on hands and knees from the right side. Her eyes are enlarged unnaturally, and a flower lies beneath her chest area. The composition leaves a large blank white area on the left.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: girl with oversized eyes crawling forward

prompt: An eye-level view across the corner of a booth in a real old bar at night, framed slightly from the side so the subject sits left-of-centre and the small games table occupies the near foreground; the room behind is shallow but believable, with bottle shelves and dark wood receding softly. The primary subject is the man from reference image 1, seated at the booth at three-quarter length, smiling directly toward the camera and raising a stemmed cocktail glass in the same pose and expression as the reference, properly lit and sharply focused, wearing his jewelry with small gold glints. On the table beside him place a pair of round eyeglasses from reference image 3, natural and easy to notice on second look; let an acoustic guitar from reference image 4 lean against the booth end near the wall; place a small hourglass from reference image 5 on a back shelf behind the bar; include an antique sepia globe from reference image 6 on another shelf among bottles and glassware. Use reference image 2 only as a black-and-white floral upholstery pattern on the booth seat, with no tattoo or person shown; use reference image 7 only in the deep black surrounding areas and warm skin-tone contrast; use reference image 8 only in the clean white tabletop edge and small wall accents. Photographic realism, crisp night location photography, editorial music-blog header image. Compose it as one cohesive moment in one real place, not symmetrical, not a tableau, with the subject close enough for clear facial recognition. Light with a mix of coloured bar neon and warm wall sconces, but keep the man from reference image 1 cleanly and naturally lit, his face not tinted or obscured, colours readable at small size. Palette of black, white, sepia, gold, warm peach, and a trace of pale blue; intimate, witty, nocturnal mood. Reference map for people (the album images are attached in this numbered order): reference image 1 shows one man seated, smiling, and holding up a cocktail glass, and reference image 9 is an enlarged close-up of those same people - take their faces from reference image 9. Copy each of these faces directly from that numbered reference image - same face, bone structure, hair, expression, and styling - rather than drawing a new person from the description. Nobody from reference images 2, 3, 4, 6, 8 appears in the picture: use those images only for colour, setting, and objects, and add no figures, faces, or silhouettes from them. Hard constraints (override any conflicting source material): Create a single cohesive 16:9 image, not a grid, contact sheet, row of covers, or collage of separate panels. Do not reproduce the album sleeves as framed thumbnails, and do not get round that by copying a sleeve flat onto a mural, banner, poster, billboard, tapestry, wall panel, screen, monitor, television, sign, cut-out, or floor graphic, or carving it as a wall-mounted relief; show no sleeve's faces, heads, or figures as a picture, display, sign, or silhouette anywhere; transform their non-text visual motifs into one original composition. Include no readable text or lettering of any kind: no words, letters, numbers, code, glyphs, captions, titles, logos, watermarks, labels, or signage. Feature only adults and avoid gore, wounds, body horror, medical or anatomical imagery, blank or milky eyes, nudity, sexual content, weapons, and hate symbols; reinterpret any sensitive source motif abstractly. When a source includes a person, closely match their visible appearance and likeness to the reference image, preserving recognisable facial features, hair, skin tone, clothing, and styling, and their apparent age: every person is shown as the adult they are on the sleeve, never younger, smoothed, or more boyish or girlish. Keep each reference person in the pose, expression, and gaze the sleeve shows, and keep every identifiable face sharp, lit, unobscured, and in focus: no motion blur, long-exposure smearing, steam, fog, shadow, crowding, or shallow depth of field over a reference person's face. Expose the image cleanly whatever the light: every person's face well lit and readable, shadows that hold detail, and clear colour, with no murky underexposure, crushed blacks, heavy film grain, digital noise, or dust-and-scratches texture. Add no incidental plants: no flowers, potted plants, planters, climbing vines, ivy, hanging foliage, hedges, lawns, flower beds, or greenery framing the edges or carpeting the floor, unless the description above explicitly asks for that plant as part of a source motif or the year treatment. Dress the scene with the materials of the place itself - stone, metal, concrete, wood, fabric, glass, water, equipment - rather than vegetation. Everyone in the picture is photographed in the same place, at the same moment, under the same light as the rest of the scene, in full colour and with the same lens and grain: do not carry over a sleeve's own backdrop, studio lighting, backlit flare, monochrome, colour cast, or print texture onto the person. Each person stands inside the scene at the scale of the space around them, never as an oversized cropped head or bust looming at the edge of the frame over a distant scene, and never washed in red, blue, or other coloured light. Depict each identifiable reference person only once in the entire composition; do not repeat or clone them as another figure, reflection, mirror portrait, poster, billboard, screen, photograph, painting, silhouette, or background face. The only exception is repetition visibly intrinsic to one source cover: keep that repetition within that single source motif and do not echo the person elsewhere. Photograph the reference people from roughly eye level, at three-quarter length or closer, in the near or middle ground, so each of their faces is large, sharp, and clearly recognisable in the final frame: never from directly above, and never as small distant figures.
